Conditionally eligible federated method in the existing proof chooser with handoff/checking/rejection feedback. Actual supported provider evidence, current policy and owner binding remain prerequisites; no automatic freshness/assurance inference.

Regular registration and later Personal Information remain unchanged. No provider capability or production policy is selected.
